newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Faulding says expects stronger year.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Faulding says expects stronger year.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals manufacturer F.H. Faulding and Co Ltd said on Monday it expected a stronger result for 1996/97 to June 30 than in 1995/96 and that it expected the second half of the year to be stronger than the first.

Faulding chairman Alan McGregor told shareholders at the company's annual meeting that financial results for the second half in recent years had exceeded those recorded for the first half, mainly due to the timing of new product approvals.
"We expect this pattern to be repeated in the current financial year," he said.
MacGregor said strategic initiatives of recent years had focused on scientific research programmes and business development activities which should provide the foundation for a sound future.

"Whilst uncertainties surrounding the timing of regulatory approvals for new products and the contribution to earnings from new business initiatives make predicting future earnings difficult, your directors are confident that future earnings will improve as a result of these important strategic activities and we expect a stronger result for the year than in the previous comparable period," McGregor said.
